extraction.Name: Susan Campbell Stover
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent in fee but took it on the recommendation of the Farmer and the Superintendent who told her that she would lose the land for taxes if she did not take the patent and pay the taxes
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: sold 160 acres of her land for $1700.00 to Ben Swallow and mortgaged the other quarter to pay taxes, having previously mortgaged it for $1000.00 to the Federal Land Co.; mortgaged the other quarter for $300.00 to pay taxes and interest on the loan she had on the first quarter
extraction.Buyer: Ben Swallow purchased 160 acres for $1700.00; Ben Swallow to pay the mortgage and gave her $700.00; Federal Land Co. held mortgage of $1000.00 on first quarter
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: mortgaged the other quarter to pay taxes; mortgaged it for $300.00 to pay taxes and interest on the loan she had on the first quarter; not able to pay the interest nor the taxes and will lose the land
extraction.Occupation/Income: supported by her husband who does common labor for a living
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent, in poor health; has nine children, two being of age and seven minors to support; has nothing but her equity in 160 acres of land but will not be able to redeem it; has received no aid from the Government, State or County since her patent was granted; affidavit subscribed and sworn before notary public on November 20, 1928; County of Shannon, State of South Dakota
